Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiasm for the Energy Marketing Coordinator position at Eastpak. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, combined with a deep passion for youth culture, fashion, and music, I am eager to contribute to Eastpak's cultural relevance and brand elevation.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed skills in project management, stakeholder coordination, and integrated campaign execution. I have successfully managed end-to-end website builds and SEO strategies, ensuring seamless delivery and measurable results. My experience working remotely with international clients has strengthened my cross-cultural communication abilities.

I am particularly drawn to Eastpak's commitment to collaborations and culture-led storytelling. My own project, mirook.com, demonstrates my ability to build a brand narrative and engage audiences through digital channels. I am confident that my organizational skills, creative mindset, and familiarity with social media and influencer marketing make me a strong fit for this role.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am excited about the opportunity to work with a global brand. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to the Eastpak team.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Energy Marketing Coordinator position at Eastpak. As a junior digital marketer with a strong foundation in SEO, content, and web development, and a genuine passion for youth culture, fashion, and music, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to Eastpak's cultural relevance and brand storytelling.

In my current role at Episto, I have developed skills directly relevant to this position. I manage on-page SEO for client websites, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra. This involves coordinating multiple projects, communicating with clients, and ensuring timely delivery—skills that align with the collaboration and project management aspects of this role. Additionally, my experience with analytics tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs has taught me how to measure and optimize campaign impact.

My own project, mirook.com, showcases my ability to build a brand from scratch. I designed and developed a multi-page site for a youth chess champion, implementing structured data and entity optimization to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project reflects my proactive, entrepreneurial spirit and my ability to create compelling narratives that resonate with audiences.

I am particularly drawn to Eastpak's focus on collaborations and culture-led storytelling. I have a natural curiosity for emerging trends and communities, and I am confident in my ability to identify partnership opportunities that authentically connect with consumers. My international experience—working remotely with diverse teams and living in Belgium with a Turkish background—has equipped me with strong cross-cultural communication skills.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, just outside Antwerp, and am eager to bring my energy and creativity to the Eastpak team. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to Eastpak's marketing initiatives.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and content creation, passionate about youth culture, fashion, and music. At Episto, I manage on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site builds, coordinating multiple projects and stakeholders. On my own project (mirook.com), I applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. Skilled in project coordination, cross-cultural communication, and integrated campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core Skills
- Project Management & Coordination: end-to-end project delivery, stakeholder management, timeline coordination
- Content & Storytelling: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, brand narrative development
- Digital Marketing & SEO: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO (AI search visibility)
- Social Media & Influencer Marketing: social media content & integration, knowledge of modern communication channels
- Web & Build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, Canva, AI-assisted content tools
- Analytics & Reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)

## Experience

### Junior Digital Marketer — Episto (Remote), 2026–present
- Own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, improving organic visibility and search rankings
- Write keyword-targeted blog content for client websites to grow organic traffic
- Build and maintain client websites in WordPress using Elementor and the Astra theme, including content uploads and page updates
- Track site performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads to guide SEO and content decisions
- Coordinate with clients and internal teams to ensure project timelines and deliverables are met

### Warehouse & Logistics — Katoen Natie (Antwerp), 2025–2026
- Maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment

### Front-End Developer — ViviDoctor (Belgium), 2018–2019
- Developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application (AngularJS, JavaScript)

## Projects

### mirook.com — Website Design, SEO & GEO (2025–present)
- Designed and built a multi-page WordPress site (Elementor, Astra) for a Belgian youth chess champion: full site structure, on-page SEO, and social media integration (Instagram/Facebook)
- Implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema, including SportsEvent and FAQPage), entity/knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines (GEO/AEO)
- Ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits, measurably raising the site's overall search-health score

## Education
- Karel de Grote Hogeschool, Antwerp — Coursework in Applied Computer Science (2022–2025)
- Celal Bayar University, Türkiye — Coursework in Computer Science (2012–2016)
